name: Hau nuong pho mai
summary: Hàu nướng phô mai is oysters grilled with cheese, a shared plate next to the snails at the evening seafood tables.
origin: Vung Tau, at the beach restaurants and the Back Beach night market.
howToEat: Order a plate to share with the snails and the rest of the evening seafood.
where: The beach restaurants and the Back Beach night market.
